title: Migration Options
description: Candidate migration paths for modernizing a legacy codebase, each scored across effort, risk, ecosystem support, and team expertise dimensions.

id.description: Unique identifier for this migration option.

name.description: Short human-readable name (e.g. 'Migrate GUI to React').

description.description: Detailed description of the migration strategy.

fromStack.description: Current technology or stack being migrated from (e.g. Vue 2, raw Makefiles).

toStack.description: Target technology or stack being migrated to (e.g. React 18, CMake).

scores.description: Multi-dimensional scoring of this migration option.

ecosystemSupport.description: Maturity and community support of the target stack (0 = poor, 1 = excellent).

teamExpertise.description: Team familiarity with the target stack (0 = none, 1 = expert).

prerequisites.description: Conditions that must be met before this migration can begin.
